title: Proteomic Analysis of HLA Complex in Solid Cancers: Breast, Ovary, Colon, Rectum, Stomach, and Pancreas
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the presence of proteins in solid tumors which may lead to an immune response
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with adenocarcinoma of breast, colon, rectum, ovary , stomach, pancreas

Exclusion Criteria:

* Withdrawal of consent
* Small specimen which does not allow to retrieve tissue without interfering with pathologic evaluation
